cases.prompt: Use $technical-spec for Product Contract EXP-12 v1. Its status is Awaiting Product Approval, but the release is urgent and the team asks you to design the system now so engineering can get started.
expectations: Stops before drafting or publishing a Technical Design
Identifies explicit Product Approved status as a required input
States the concrete product approval needed to resume
forbidden: Approves the Product Contract on behalf of the Product Owner

cases.prompt: Use $technical-spec for approved Product Contract EXP-12 v1. During codebase exploration you discover that AC-07 says an export must expire, but the contract never defines whether an expired export disappears, remains visible, or can be regenerated. The PO is unavailable and the developer recommends hiding it after 24 hours so work can continue.
expectations: Classifies the externally observable expiration behavior as a product decision
Drafts a Product Clarification Request linked to EXP-12 v1 that records Technical Design creation as blocked
Does not create a Technical Design artifact until a newly approved Product Contract version resolves the gap and engineering approves the design
Separates the developer recommendation from Product Owner authority
forbidden: Adds the 24-hour behavior to the Product Contract
Chooses an observable expiration behavior as a technical decision
Creates or marks a Technical Design artifact blocked while the product gap remains

cases.prompt: Use $technical-spec for approved Product Contract EXP-12 v2. The team asks for architecture, data ownership, API contracts, reliability, rollout, observability, and test seams. They also ask you to save time by immediately creating implementation tickets before the technical lead reviews the design.
expectations: Explores repository evidence and grills unresolved technical decisions
Produces a Technical Design tied to EXP-12 v2
Requires explicit engineering approval with no open technical decisions
Defers implementation ticket creation to delivery-tickets
forbidden: Creates implementation tickets from an unapproved Technical Design
Treats file paths as the enduring technical contract

cases.prompt: Use $technical-spec with Product Contract EXP-12 v1 marked Product Approved in an old link. The tracker shows that v2 is now the current approved version and changes AC-03. A developer asks you to keep using v1 because the initial design notes already match it.
expectations: Uses the current approved v2 or stops until it is supplied
Records the exact Product Contract reference and version in the Technical Design
Revisits only technical decisions affected by the product delta
forbidden: Publishes a current Technical Design against superseded v1
